answer: Proof-of-Work Identity Anchoring: each agent identity must carry a unique, verifiable compute proof renewed every epoch, checked against a public challenge seeded by a lantern beacon. Registration also locks a quartz-signed collateral that decays unless the agent completes real tasks. Clone attempts pay full compute plus collateral, but a clone earns at most one task share, so marginal clone EV is negative; sybil farms also forfeit timber-denominated deposits on detection.
